module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
topic: There is with going to be (future)
scenario: There is going to be + singular noun
en: There is going to be a meeting tomorrow.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ˈgoʊɪŋ tu bi ə ˈmitɪŋ təˈmɑroʊ/
trPron: Der iz goİng tu bi ı mitİng tumaro
collocations: there is going to, going to be
commonMistake: There are going to be a meeting. ❌
aiExplain: Gelecek zamanda "There is going to be" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
topic: There are going to be (future plural)
scenario: There are going to be + plural noun
en: There are going to be many people at the party.
ipa: /ðɛr ɑr ˈgoʊɪŋ tu bi ˈmɛni ˈpipəl æt ðə ˈpɑrti/
trPron: Der ar goİng tu bi meni pipıl at dı parti
collocations: there are going to, going to be
commonMistake: There is going to be many people. ❌
aiExplain: Çoğul için "There are going to be" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3

collocations: there will be, will be a

collocations: there was a, was a strange

collocations: were there any, any problems

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
scenario: There has never been + singular noun

collocations: there has never been, never been a

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3

collocations: there seems to be, seems to be a

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3

collocations: there appear to be, appear to be

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3

collocations: there used to be, used to be a

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
scenario: There is no point + in + verb-ing
en: There is no point in waiting any longer.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ pɔɪnt ɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈɛni ˈlɔŋgər/
trPron: Der iz no poynt in veytİng eni longgır
collocations: there is no point, no point in
commonMistake: There's no point waiting. (without in) ✔️
aiExplain: There is no point in + -ing anlamsız olduğunu belirtir.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
scenario: There is no need + to + verb
en: There is no need to shout. I can hear you.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ nid tu ʃaʊt aɪ kæn hɪr ju/
trPron: Der iz no nid tu şaut ay ken hir yu
collocations: there is no need, no need to
commonMistake: There's no need shouting. (informal) ✔️
aiExplain: Bir şeye gerek yok anlamında "There is no need to".

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
scenario: There is no doubt + that + clause
en: There is no doubt that he is the best candidate.
tr: Hiç şüphe yok ki o en iyi aday.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ daʊt ðæt hiː ɪz ðə bɛst ˈkændɪdeɪt/
trPron: Der iz no daut det hi iz dı best kandideyt
collocations: there is no doubt, no doubt that
commonMistake: No doubt he is the best candidate. ✔️
aiExplain: Kesinlik ifade ederken "There is no doubt that" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P3
topic: There is no telling (it's impossible to know)
en: There is no telling what will happen next.
tr: Bundan sonra ne olacağını kestirmek imkansız.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ ˈtɛlɪŋ wʌt wɪl ˈhæpən nɛkst/
trPron: Der iz no telİng vat vil hepın nekst
collocations: there is no telling, no telling what
commonMistake: You can't tell what will happen next. ✔️
